title: Predicting extremely low body weight from 12-lead electrocardiograms using a deep neural network
summary: A 1D CNN learns from 12-lead ECG waveforms to identify BMI ≤12.6 kg/m² in a retrospective inpatient cohort; splitting by patient, the test set of 187 ECG/BMI pairs yielded AUC 0.807 (95% CI 0.745–0.869), sensitivity 0.702 and specificity 0.796. Scope is this mostly female single-center cohort. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
